description: Lists the sandbox agent's most recent payment attempts, newest first: paid (amount and mock transaction hash), refused (reason codes) and waiting for approval. Use it to report what happened so far or to find a receipt id; after a hold, the approval id is in the sandbox_pay result. Returns up to `limit` lines, one per attempt, with time, receipt id, method, URL, amount and status, or "No payments yet." Read-only.

limit.description: How many attempts to return, newest first (1 to 100, default 10)

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox_id returned by sandbox_create (32 hex characters)

name: list_receipts
title: List receipts
